checks.title: Source accepted
checks.description: Source accepted without logging any media content.
checks.scenario: A supported file or canonical YouTube video is submitted.

checks.title: Queue respects engine ownership
checks.description: Queue respects engine ownership without logging any media content.
checks.scenario: A waiting transcript acquires the engine gate after other work finishes.

checks.title: Transcription completed
checks.description: Transcription completed without logging any media content.
checks.scenario: A local model finishes the complete audio track.

checks.title: Cancellation keeps partial text
checks.description: Cancellation keeps partial text without logging any media content.
checks.scenario: A running or queued transcript is cancelled.

checks.title: Failure remains recoverable
checks.description: Failure remains recoverable without logging any media content.
checks.scenario: A source, model or memory failure leaves the partial result available.

checks.title: Edited text saved
checks.description: Edited text saved without logging any media content.
checks.scenario: A completed transcript is edited and saved.

checks.title: History deletion cleans files
checks.description: History deletion cleans files without logging any media content.
checks.scenario: A transcript and its source are deleted after its worker stops.

checks.title: Private mode refuses persistent writes
checks.description: Server rejects content persistence in an active private session.
checks.scenario: A client attempts to create, edit or retry a persistent transcript during a private session.
